dependency_review_notes.tests/integration/test_admin_identity_op: Releitura dos12casos/fixtures: cada DB aleatória sólocal, fakebridge status+backup; provas30schema/setup/registeractivate, adulteração, flags/nonce/sessão, rotação/owner, gate29/30, accountquerycompat, CHECK/singleton, register28/29.
dependency_review_notes.tests/unit/test_admin_demo_setup.py: Releitura dos9casos sem banco: disabled, plan padrão, flagsIA/canais preservados, tools0/1, nonce/proof e limite realname120.
dependency_review_notes.tests/integration/test_legacy_admin_runt: Releitura dos8casos: PG real, sender in-memory, native contaUUID, revogaçãoENV/flag/versão/owner e GUC restrito à transação/tenant; nenhuma mensagem real.
dependency_review_notes.app/inbox_conversations.py: Releitura integral de channels, messages/preserved_history/mark_read/enqueue e callers. Apenas fila humana persistente e leituras autorizadas; a alteração de erro sem UUID não ativa transportes nem cria identidade.

Sem fallback ao OWNER; rejeita outro papel, host não loopback, endpoint diferente, queryoverride e DB fora da fixture. Nenhum acesso de rede/banco.

dependency_review_notes.tests/integration/test_qr_admin_identity: Releitura dos14casos previamente PG verdes e delta apenas de fixture: cadeia completa importada e engine agora deriva case.support_url configurada, sem manter senha OWNER. App QR inalterado; três casos focados e CI SCRAM registram a nova qualificação separadamente.

admin_lease_followup_review.review_method: Manual complete snapshot/plan/execute/capture_dump/verify_restore/apply reread; compared exact existing adoption lease projection and its callers; tests read in full.

dependency_review_notes.scripts/one_time_admin_demo_setup.py: Only setup.snapshot normalizes qr_channels.lease_owner/lease_expires_at/fence/updated_at exactly as existing adoption. Same projected SELECT recomputes row hash and count in every plan/backup/restore/apply/exclude path. All other QR fields, rows, other tables, catalog/ACL/RLS/programs/sequence remain bound. Setup never writes QR leases. Full encrypted pg_dump and actual restore/rehearsal unchanged; existing session HMAC/ENV credential/flags/nonce checks remain mandatory.
dependency_review_notes.tests/integration/test_admin_identity_op: Read all original operator cases plus three lease regressions. Real PG positive renews before backup and after rehearsal, checks fresh full QR row remains byte/value identical after setup. Negative case mutates ten identity/configuration fields and revokes owner membership; old approval fails before backup. Post-rehearsal revision mutation fails source preservation without domain writes. Fake bridge/provider only.
dependency_review_notes.tests/unit/test_admin_demo_setup.py: Read all original nine config/proof cases and new pure three-process/hash-seed regression. Stable snapshot/plan hashes; only four lease fields tolerated. QR identity/tenant/label/owner/revision/credentials/allowlist/idempotency/fingerprint/creation timestamp plus other-table rows/session/credential binding remain protected.

admin_lease_followup_review.reproduction: Before fix, one pure subprocess test and one real PostgreSQL lease-only positive failed with changed approval hashes; actual original full production snapshots unavailable, so the specific production changed row is not asserted.
admin_lease_followup_review.executed_results: 10 focused unit cases passed (three fresh Python processes/seeds); all 15 PostgreSQL operator cases passed, including three new lease/configuration regressions. Full proof recorded separately in admin-lease-test-evidence.json.

qr_adoption_scope_followup_review.review_method: Manual full changed functions, authenticated caller, request scope/transaction guard, persistent control reads/cleanup/handoff and new test sources; AST only verifies unchanged inventoried bodies and source offsets.
qr_adoption_scope_followup_review.scope_semantics: Only authenticated ChannelIdentity can enable persisted adoption with global0. blocked/revision reads happen after binding, all early returns/errors/cancellation restore tokens. Effective control also clears only old provisional human/commerce/birthday context; verified receipts/new review draft remain preserved. Human/pending modes, stale revision/lease/owner/tenant/sender and write guards remain fail-closed.

dependency_review_notes.app/qr_channel_scope.py: Read complete typed scope and transaction hold: same task/session/transaction plus equality identity; pre/post SQL authority checks, request guard revalidation and token reset. No transport or session credential writes.
dependency_review_notes.tests/unit/test_qr_managed_adoption_scop: Read all new synthetic adopted/global0+1 cases: pauses/pending, failed/missing/stale intake, duplicate, seven identity revocations, human takeover, cancellation, two Redis-resume variants and persistent handoff. SQL/Redis/inference local fakes; actual unit results owned separately by API agent.
dependency_review_notes.tests/integration/test_qr_adopted_ingres: Read and executed five real PG16 cases: initial authority global0/1, existing human/paused, changed fence before initial control; authenticated HTTP/RLS and transaction_guard/public SQL functions real, run_locked replaced with read-only synthetic inference, sent list empty.

Regressões isoladas executadas em api-fixes.xml. Ingressos QR são bridge key+allowlist ou ChannelIdentity autenticada com lease/fence+tenant; run_locked serializa namespace, deduplica e revalida intake_revision e controle antes/depois de domínio. Subfunções só produzem answer/step; turn formata preservando limites, e bridge decide envio após recibos. Prévia usa namespace preview/ator/sessão, preview true e não grava reserva/envia WhatsApp. Literal/ramo corrente: ["Encerrei somente a consulta de disponibilidade. source_record.rationale: managed_qr_reply: Identidade vem da credencial/lease do canal, namespace derivado da própria identidade; controle humano bloqueia IA e guard é revalidado, sem aceitar tenant do payload. Ingressos QR são bridge key+allowlist ou ChannelIdentity autenticada com lease/fence+tenant; run_locked serializa namespace, deduplica e revalida intake_revision e controle antes/depois de domínio. Subfunções só produzem answer/step; turn formata preservando limites, e bridge decide envio após recibos. Prévia usa namespace preview/ator/sessão, preview true e não grava reserva/envia WhatsApp. A instrução original foi correlacionada ao corpo atual da função; a faixa inteira foi lida, sem presumir equivalência textual do trecho antigo. Entrada gerenciada relida: bind da ChannelIdentity autenticada precede blocked/assistant_revision; intake e consultas iniciais ficam no try/finally antes de bind_assistant. run_locked usa inbox_control.enabled() efetivo para limpar handoff e escolher controlador persistente, incluindo central_adopted/global0. Relidos authenticated_channel, scope bind/assert_current/transaction_guard, control enabled/blocked/assistant_revision/clear_transient_handoff e tenant_transaction; mantidos lease/fence, revisão, pausa humana, idempotência e recibos.

record.status_at_handoff: static fix reread: handler and store reject expired/missing/naive/far-future cancellation deadline; root isolated tests pending
record.trigger: Cliente recebe cancel_proposal de pedido confirmado, não envia outra mensagem, bridge permanece no mesmo processo/geração e só responde podecancelar dias depois, antes do TTL7dias do estado.
record.observed_static_behavior: pending cancel salva action/order_id/revision/summary_message_id sem expires_at. Avançar relógio além do prazo mantendo revision e same last_message.
Responder podecancelar; aceitar somente novo resumo, sem cancel_order e sem release de estoque.
Após novo resumo aceito e mensagem distinta dentro prazo, cancelar uma vez e retornar recibo verificado.
record.implementation_review_note: Root added pending.expires_at aware now+15min, handler cancellation_live check and store.cancel_order summary_expires_at recheck before stock/status writes. Alreadycancelled result remains idempotent. No new migration required.
